Select: SELECT Id, Name||' '||Father||' '||LName AS Name FROM Lrg_Borrower
Condition: id IN (SELECT borrower_Id FROM Lrg_Req WHERE Loan_isPayments_Id = 1 AND Status_Id IN (SELECT RStatus_Id FROM Cpy_Unit_Rec_Status WHERE Unit_Id IN (SELECT Unit_ID FROM Cpy_User_Unit WHERE user_id={userId})) AND Status_Id in (select Cstatus_id from Cpy_VStatus_Grp where  UPPER(Mst_Name)=UPPER('borrowerPayment')))
